author: @FrankCurzio
text:
People have no idea how bad this stock selloff just got.

60% of stocks are down more than 20%.

Tech & AI is getting crushed, and money is quietly moving into one sector nobody is talking about.

Here's the sector + 6 stocks I'm watching: 👇

author: @FrankCurzio
text:
Healthcare.

Fund managers oversee trillions of dollars, and they don't earn fees sitting in cash.

That money goes somewhere, and right now it's leaving tech for drug makers that can keep raising prices.

4 healthcare stocks + 2 AI names I'm watching for the pullback:

author: @FrankCurzio
text:
1. $LLY - Eli Lilly

Sitting near its all-time high while most stocks are down 20% or more.

The reason is pricing power. It can charge more without losing customers, and that's exactly what big money hunts for when everything else is falling:

author: @FrankCurzio
text:
2. $AMGN - Amgen

Another drug maker trading near its high.

With energy, interest rates and debt costs all climbing, the companies that can pass those costs on are the ones holding up:

author: @FrankCurzio
text:
3. $UNH - UnitedHealth

As a customer, it's frustrating: massive premiums that rise every year, and 20 phone calls to get anything covered.

As a stock, health insurers like this are just printing money.

author: @FrankCurzio
text:
4. $MRK - Merck

Even Merck is doing better as the money rotates into healthcare.

The last two picks are tech names, and I'm not buying them yet. I'm waiting for this selloff to hand them to me cheaper:

author: @FrankCurzio
text:
5. $CRWV - CoreWeave

Down 40% from its highs.

The business is good and demand for what it sells is intact. The stock is getting dragged down with the rest of AI, and that's when I want to be ready:

author: @kei_toshi__
text:
どこまで株価上げるの？って指を咥えてみているしかない銘柄

第1位 「JT(日本たばこ産業)

どんどん株価を上げているJT。気づけば株価は7,500円付近。昔は株価2,000円とかで買えたのに気づけば4倍近くに株価は上昇。しかもこれで高配当で無敵。
いつも押し目がきたら買い増ししたい！って思うが一向にこない...🥲
ほんとどこまで株価を上げるのか？
指を咥えて見つめるしかない....。

text:
